jobs.subject: Preserve the exact approved YUWAN whale-girl identity in the first reference: deep blue eyes, layered blue bob with long curled side locks/braids, white sailor beret with tiny whale emblem and navy bow, navy-and-white frilly sailor dress, white socks and navy Mary Jane shoes, prominent blue whale tail. jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D game character spritesheet for the Lingjing desktop companion game. Using the referenced approved art for identity and painterly anime style, make ONE polished square 2048 x 2048 RGBA sprite atlas, EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows = 16 equally sized invisible cells. One complete full-body character in every cell, same character, clothing, proportions and scale. This is a sprite atlas, not a contact sheet with panels: no background, no borders, no labels, no text, no checkerboard, no watermark. Real alpha transparency everywhere outside painted character/effects. No white rectangles. Fine clean colored linework, dimensional soft painterly anime shading, crisp readable silhouette, consistent costume detail. Do not make geometric stand-ins, recolors, 3D renders or icons.
Grid constraints: place the center of each character at the horizontal center of its own cell. Foot/ground baseline is 88% down each cell; keep head and all limbs/effects at least 8% inside all cell edges. Standard standing character fills about 72% cell height, with transparent padding and identical scale. Sleeping poses remain grounded on that same baseline. No part may cross into another cell. Facing gently to viewer's right in a consistent three-quarter front view.
EXACT frame order, read left to right then top to bottom:
ROW 1: [0] neutral standing idle, eyes open, hands/paws relaxed; [1] same idle with BOTH eyes closed in a blink; [2] walk stride left leg/paw forward right back; [3] opposite walking stride right forward left back.
ROW 2: [4] friendly greeting with one raised hand/paw palm outward; [5] second greeting, hand/paw tilted outward and happy smile; [6] eating, bringing a small appropriate snack toward mouth; [7] chewing with snack partly eaten, cheeks puffed and hands/paws near mouth.
ROW 3: [8] ordinary attack WINDUP: lower stance, hand/paw drawn BACK, focused expression; [9] ordinary attack RELEASE: clear forceful forward thrust/sweep with the character's small elemental arc; [10] TAKING A HIT: unmistakable backward recoil, eyes squeezed, shoulders scrunched and arms/paws recoiling, small impact spark; [11] skill CHARGING: grounded stance, both hands/paws cupping a glowing elemental motif.
ROW 4: [12] skill RELEASE: distinctly extended commanding pose with a larger magical motif contained within the cell, unlike the ordinary attack; [13] VICTORY: cheerful triumphant arms/paws raised, joyful eyes and tiny stars; [14] SLEEP: curled/seated sleeping peacefully eyes shut; [15] second sleep breath pose, subtly changed head/arms/tail.
The frames must show genuinely DIFFERENT anatomy and poses, not repeated standing images with different effects. In particular attack windup, attack release, hit, skill charge/release MUST NOT reuse a wave/greeting pose. Every frame remains the same identity. Only show handheld food in the two eating frames. Magic effects only in attack/skill/hit/victory frames. Use the approved UI art as visual reference only; output no UI.
CHARACTER IDENTITY:
Preserve the exact approved YUWAN whale-girl identity in the first reference: deep blue eyes, layered blue bob with long curled side locks/braids, white sailor beret with tiny whale emblem and navy bow, navy-and-white frilly sailor dress, white socks and navy Mary Jane shoes, prominent blue whale tail. Gentle reserved expression. Her silhouette includes the beret and whale tail. Snack is a rice ball. Ordinary attack is a small water crescent; skill is a glowing turquoise wave-and-whale motif.
